name: Kalua Pork
body:
Station and Complexity rotisseur 3

Flavor Profiles umami, salty, sweet
Additional Ingredients bitter, spicy, sour, or sweet

EFFECT

Duration 1 minute/level; Serving Size 1

DESCRIPTION

Kalua pork is a pork butt roast that is traditionally seasoned with salt and buried underground to smoke while wrapped in ti (asparagus) or banana leaves.

When consumed, it grants a burrow speed of 15 feet (or 10 feet if the consumer wears medium or heavy armor, or if it carries a medium or heavy load) through sand, loose soil, or gravel, or at a speed of 5 feet through stone for the duration (divided between all consumers). Burrowing in this way requires only as much concentration as walking, so the consumer can attack or cast spells normally, but it cannot charge or run. Loose material collapses behind the consumer 1 round after it leaves the area. This meal does not give the target the ability to breathe underground, so when passing through loose material, the consumer must hold its breath and take only short trips, or else it may suffocate.

Additional ingredients increase the serving size by +1 each.

Additional spicy or sour ingredients increases burrowing speed through stone by +5 feet, to a maximum of burrow 15 feet.

Additional sweet ingredients increase all burrow speeds granted by the kalua pork by +5 feet, and increases their maximum by +5 feet.
